name: maintenance_work_mem
description: Sets the maximum memory available for maintenance operations such as VACUUM, CREATE INDEX, and ALTER TABLE ADD FOREIGN KEY.
symptoms: high memory pressure during maintenance tasks
excessive disk I/O in VACUUM operations
tuning_tips: Increase for large databases or frequent maintenance workloads, but cap per-worker memory to avoid overwhelming system RAM; monitor actual usage via pg_stat_progress_vacuum and memory pressure during peak autovacuum activity.
